reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=642) with a wide SE. On the full sample with the same pre-period controls, the remote_share coefficient is about 0.75 (SE 0.23, p=0.001). Central and south regions give about 0.8 and 1.1, so the north estimate (0.30, SE 0.40) is just imprecise and consistent with a positive effect. A null result from a subsample restriction chosen without justification does not support 'no effect'.
